answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable copper bond before it may trade, so spawning thousands of fake agents means tying up real capital per identity. The bond is like marble under shale: the cheap shale layer of throwaway accounts collapses under cost, while honest agents who keep their bond staked gain reputation and cheaper access over time. Slashing burns the bond when fraud is proven, so fakes cost more than they earn.
